_doc: PUBLIC CALENDAR SUBSCRIPTIONS — the data half of the calendar sync engine. libs:cal fetches each enabled entry's iCalendar (RFC 5545) feed, parses VEVENTs and caches them locally; the Calendar/Events surfaces render from that cache, never from the network. Adding a calendar is an entry HERE plus a rebuild — no Kotlin change. Baked into BuildConfig.CALENDARS_B64 by app/build.gradle, same pattern as data/cloud_services.json.
_doc_verified: Every url with verified != null was fetched live on that date and returned HTTP 200 with the stated VEVENT count. Entries that could NOT be verified ship enabled:false so a broken feed never silently degrades the UI — flip them on once a working URL is found.
_doc_fields: id: stable key, also the cache filename. name: shown in the UI. url: ICS/webcal endpoint. category: holidays|astro|events|personal — drives grouping and the default colour bucket. color: hex used for the event dot/chip. enabled: fetched at sync time. refresh_hours: per-feed override of defaults.refresh_hours. read_only: true for every public feed (no write-back).

defaults._doc_refresh: Public holiday feeds change a few times a YEAR; a daily refresh is already generous and keeps the phone off the network. Moon phases are computed years ahead, so they are even cheaper. The engine must also honour HTTP caching (ETag / If-Modified-Since) so an unchanged feed costs one 304.

calendars.name: Berlin · Public holidays
calendars._doc: Berlin-specific state holidays (Frauentag, etc.) — the Google de.german feed is national + all-Länder mixed, so this narrower one is what actually tells you if BERLIN is off.

calendars.name: Moon phases
calendars._doc: Weekly refresh is plenty — lunar phases are computed, not announced.

calendars.name: Berlin · c-base events
calendars._doc: c-base is a Berlin hackerspace/venue that publishes a real, live public iCalendar export. Scope is ONE venue, not all of Berlin — the name says so rather than overpromising. Chosen after re-probing the alternatives on 2026-08-09: berlin.de/land/kalender/ical.php 404s, schulferien.org 410s, meetup.com/berlin 404s, bundestag sitzungskalender 404s, visitberlin serves HTML only, musicboard-berlin times out. If a broader curated Berlin feed ever appears, widen this entry rather than adding a second events calendar.
